communityPosts.title: Official Call for Papers — National Engineering Symposium 2026
communityPosts.author: Chapter Chairman
communityPosts.content: We invite all undergraduate, postgraduate scholars, and faculty mentors of Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute to submit high-quality research papers for the National Engineering Symposium 2026. Focus tracks include Clean Energy Systems, Autonomous Robotics, and Generative Artificial Intelligence in Manufacturing. Selected papers will be included in the official Chapter proceedings.
